title: Refuge of sinners
html_source:
Refugium Peccatorum meaning Refuge of Sinners is a Roman Catholic title for the Blessed Virgin Mary. Its use goes back to Saint Germanus of Constantinople in the 8th century.
Wikipedia

From the ‘Litany of Our lady’, (Gifford & Seidman, p391).
